annotations.title: Add a saved pick to my list

description: Add a pick you can read, usually one from saved_items, to one of your own lists as a new pick. Carries the facts (title, link, place, type) and records where it was found; the note starts empty because the source curator's words are theirs. Does not change the source list or the save.

idempotency_key.description: Stable across retries so a lost response does not add the pick twice.

itemId.description: Item id from saved_items or get_list_items.

list.description: Your list slug or title. Call list_my_lists if unsure.

name: add_saved_item
